snippet.title: Airport Contraband - Demo Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Caldora Airport, where the line between security and chaos is as thin as a forged passport. In this roguelike simulation, you step into the boots of a customs officer where every passenger has a story—and some have a hidden agenda.

Wishlist NOW - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167820/Airport_Contraband/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=DemoTeaser

Experience the tension yourself when the Playable Demo drops on April 23, 2026!
